summary:
# Martian Map 3D – Project Summary

**Martian Map 3D** is an interactive 3D Mars exploration platform designed to help users investigate the Martian surface and evaluate potential locations for future human exploration and settlement.

The platform features a rotatable and zoomable 3D model of Mars, allowing users to explore named geographical locations, examine scientific descriptions and coordinates, and measure distances between locations. It also provides a location-comparison system that considers important environmental factors, including water availability, terrain conditions, temperature, sunlight exposure, and radiation protection.

Users can adjust the importance of different survival factors to compare locations and identify potentially suitable areas for future exploration and settlement. A guided exploration feature further helps users understand Mars and its geographical characteristics.

The project's broader goal is to make planetary science more interactive, accessible, and useful for understanding the challenges of human exploration beyond Earth.

Martian Map 3D – Project Information

Project Name: Martian Map 3D

Project Category: Space Exploration, Planetary Science and 3D Visualization

Field: Space Technology and Scientific Research

Target Planet: Mars

Project Purpose: To provide an interactive platform for exploring Mars and identifying geographical locations that may be suitable for future human exploration and settlement.

Key Features:

  • Interactive 3D visualization of Mars.
  • Exploration of Martian geographical locations.
  • Display of location coordinates and scientific information.
  • Distance measurement between selected locations.
  • Comparison of locations using environmental and survival factors.
  • Evaluation of terrain, temperature, sunlight, water availability and radiation protection.
  • Interactive exploration and educational experience.

Target Audience:

  • Students and educators.
  • Space science enthusiasts.
  • Researchers.
  • Planetary scientists.
  • Future space explorers.

Problem Being Addressed: Understanding Mars and identifying potentially suitable locations for human exploration requires accessible geographical and environmental information.

Proposed Solution: An interactive 3D platform that brings Martian geographical data and environmental comparisons together in one place.

Long-Term Vision: To contribute to the understanding of Mars and support research into the possibilities and challenges of future human settlement beyond Earth.
